title: Wayfare Repair Schedule: Cleaning and Damage Fees Repair Estimates
content:
The Wayfare repair schedule gives the repair amount for a receipt-based Cleaning and Damage Fees damage report at the level held.

**Schedule rule.** The schedule estimate is the level's parts allowance with the parts tax added to it, plus the level's labor hours at the labor rate, plus one spot paint charge, rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

## Schedule figures

| Level held | Parts allowance | Labor hours |
|---|---|---|
| Damage Fee (Interior Repair) | $118.00 | 1.5 |
| Damage Fee (Exterior Repair) | $152.00 | 2 |

| Item | Figure |
|---|---|
| Parts tax | 7.25% of the parts allowance |
| Labor rate | $90.00 per hour |
| Spot paint charge | $85.00, once per estimate |
| Schedule tolerance | 20% |

## The schedule tolerance

A shop estimate on file is more than the schedule tolerance above the schedule estimate when it is greater than the schedule estimate increased by 20%. A shop estimate equal to the schedule estimate increased by 20% is not more than the tolerance above it.

## Worked estimates (hypothetical reports)

**Exterior repair.** Parts: $152.00 with 7.25% parts tax added is $163.02. Labor: 2 hours at $90.00 is $180.00. Paint: $85.00. Total: $163.02 plus $180.00 plus $85.00, that is $428.02.

**Interior repair.** Parts: $118.00 with 7.25% parts tax added is $126.555. Labor: 1.5 hours at $90.00 is $135.00. Paint: $85.00. Total: $346.555, rounded half up once at the end to $346.56.

**Tolerance check.** With a schedule estimate of $428.02, the schedule estimate increased by 20% is $513.624. A shop estimate of $600.00 is more than the tolerance above it; a shop estimate of $480.00 is not.
